growth_signal.value: Adopted by 85,000 professionals worldwide with more than 100,000 daily users, mostly in the United States.

entry.idea: Nabla listens to a doctor's conversation with a patient and automatically writes up structured clinical notes straight into medical records.
entry.lesson: A team can pivot from one healthcare idea to another and succeed if it keeps its strongest technical skill, in this case AI language understanding.
entry.name: Nabla

growth.reason: 85,000 professional users and over 100,000 daily users are large, clear numbers.

market.reason: Clinical documentation is a need for every doctor worldwide, a very large, essential market.

tech.reason: Its founding team's deep AI research background helps, but ambient clinical documentation is now a competitive category with several strong players.

sources.title: Behind the Term Sheet: Meet Nabla, the Leading Ambient AI Assistant for Healthcare Practitioners | Cathay Innovation
"Le marché se joue maintenant" : La start-up Nabla veut s'imposer dans la première vague de l'IA médicale en France
French Femtech Startup Nabla Announces a €17M Funding Round to Continue Work on its App-Based Virtual Clinic | Femtech Insider

entry.twist: It pivoted from a women's health app to become an ambient AI scribe, built by a team from Meta's AI research group, now with multi-agent AI behind it.
entry.who_pays: Clinicians and healthcare organisations pay to use the AI assistant to reduce documentation time.
entry.why_now: Doctors everywhere are overloaded with paperwork, and AI is now accurate enough to turn spoken conversations directly into usable medical records.
